sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The RB-AO key (RB-AO) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to one of the Federal State Reserve Agency base guard barracks' armories.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Shoreline
sections.text: - In the bunker to the north of the health resort, on the bed.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Inside the Military Barracks in the North West of Reserve. (Highlighted in green)

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Loose loot (Weapon mods)
- 5x Weapon racks (AK-74N, AKS-74U, AKS-74N, AKS-74UB, AKS-74UN)
